next_step_summary: PR #226 adds a bounded Surya 2 raw-fullframe benchmark worker against the clarified v1 contract. It pins surya-ocr 0.22.1 in a separate benchmark environment, accepts at most ten local image pages in explicit page order, validates encoded bytes, dimensions and pixels before OCR, applies only EXIF orientation normalization, runs full-page OCR in memory, validates full-frame geometry, confidence, ordering and output bounds, supports exact partial-failure page coverage, and persists only non-sensitive aggregate metrics. No deskew, crop, perspective correction, grayscale requirement, Android preprocessing handoff or production data flow is added. Repository validation uses an injected synthetic engine because Surya and its inference backend are not installed in the current environment. After merge, run surya-raw-fullframe-gpu-execution-v1 on approved GPU infrastructure with approved non-identifying full-frame benchmark pages and record Hebrew quality and layout, cold and warm latency, queue delay, GPU and VRAM behavior, OOM, billed seconds and cost, log hygiene, cleanup, regional and retention evidence, and whether image preprocessing is actually needed. Android audit findings #2 and #3 remain deferred until that Android path is reused as OCR input.
